description: Estimate a sun session's outcome: 'I was (or will be) out N minutes — how much vitamin D did I make?' plus 'how long before I'd burn?' for the profile. Takes a start time (defaults to the day's best hour) and session minutes; returns estimated IU (with the physiological cap), average UV and clear-sky minutes-to-sunburn. Use for any 'how much did I get / can I get in X minutes' or 'how long without burning' question.

age.description: Age in years (synthesis declines with age); omit for adult baseline

date.description: Date as YYYY-MM-DD; defaults to today

elevationM.description: Ground elevation in metres (UV rises ~8%/km); default sea level

exposedSkinFraction.description: Skin exposed: 0.10 face+hands, 0.18 face+arms, 0.25 t-shirt+shorts (default), 0.40 swimsuit

skinType.description: Fitzpatrick skin type 1 (very fair) to 6 (very dark); default 3

startTime.description: Local HH:MM the session starts; defaults to the day's best hour

timezone.description: IANA timezone like 'Europe/Madrid'. Strongly recommended — without it all times are UTC

name: estimate_sun_session
